purpose: A complete and bijective 2 x 2 that must NOT be merged. It proves the relation bridge alone cannot stop a false merge, and that internal fragment support is doing real work.
note: Fixed before the fixture was compiled. The gt gates run first: if the fixture did not come out as designed, the rescue expectation is meaningless and must not be checked or relaxed.

gt_gate_failure_meanings.fewer_than_2_addresses: a kernel was inlined or folded away despite inline(never); the fixture source is wrong
gt_gate_failure_meanings.left_and_right_share_an_address: identical-code folding merged the two kernels, so the salts did not separate them and the negative control is void

why_this_is_the_whole_point: The A0/A1 axis varies inside each fragment, so it has internal support.
The left/right axis only separates the two fragments and never varies within one, so it has none.
Both kernels call the same common_marker and the same A-dependent callee, so the relation bridge condition passes and cannot be what refuses the merge.
not_asserted: Whether any callsite resolves as unresolved or filtered. Rust source cannot force angr to fail, so resolver state is reported and never gated.
The names of the source functions. F7 recovers anonymous axes.
